docs.title: Media Cover Art
docs.text: Resolve and cache film/TV cover art for library paths under Films and TV, using Radarr/Sonarr first and TMDB as fallback.

docs.title: Status
docs.text: Phase 0 — identity parsing, Policy C title matching, and cache models are available now. The sync client (CoverArtClient.ensure_posters, resolve, hydrate, purge) lands in Phase 1.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
from media_cover_art import parse_media_identity

identity = parse_media_identity(
    "/Media/TV/100 Foot Wave/Season 1/"
    "100 Foot Wave - S01E01 - Chapter I – Sea Monsters WEBDL-1080p.mkv"
)
print(identity.cache_key)      # tvshow:100-foot-wave
print(identity.display_title)  # 100 Foot Wave · S01E01 · Chapter I – Sea Monsters

See Install and the API reference.

docs.title: API reference
docs.text:
Resolve and cache film/TV cover art from Radarr, Sonarr, and TMDB.

Phase 0 exports identity parsing, title matching, and cache models. The sync client (ensure/resolve/purge) lands in a later phase.

docs.title: parse_media_identity(source_path)
docs.text:
Derive film/TV identity from a full media path.

Paths under Films / TV (case-insensitive path segments) produce film or TV identities. Anything else is unknown and will not trigger remote cover-art lookups.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default source_path str

Full POSIX (or Windows) path as stored in Mongo.

required

Returns:

Type Description MediaIdentity

A MediaIdentity including cache_key and display_title.

Source code in src/media_cover_art/identity.py 
def parse_media_identity(source_path: str) -> MediaIdentity:
    """Derive film/TV identity from a full media path.

    Paths under ``Films`` / ``TV`` (case-insensitive path segments) produce
    film or TV identities. Anything else is ``unknown`` and will not trigger
    remote cover-art lookups.

    Args:
        source_path: Full POSIX (or Windows) path as stored in Mongo.

    Returns:
        A ``MediaIdentity`` including ``cache_key`` and ``display_title``.
    """
    parts = _path_parts(source_path)
    lowered = [part.lower() for part in parts]

    if "films" in lowered:
        return _parse_film(source_path, parts, lowered.index("films"))
    if "tv" in lowered:
        return _parse_tv(source_path, parts, lowered.index("tv"))

    basename = Path(source_path).name
    return MediaIdentity(
        kind="unknown",
        title=Path(basename).stem or basename,
        source_path=source_path,
        display_title=basename,
        cache_key=f"unknown:{_slug_for_cache(basename)}",
    )

def normalize_title(value: str) -> str:
    """Lowercase a title and strip quality tokens / punctuation noise.

    Args:
        value: Raw title, folder name, or basename fragment.

    Returns:
        Normalized lowercase string suitable for slug or match prep.
    """
    cleaned = QUALITY_TOKENS.sub(" ", value)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[._]+", " ", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip().lower()
    return cleaned

def fold_title_for_match(value: str) -> str:
    """Normalize and fold punctuation so colons/dashes do not block equality.

    Args:
        value: Raw title from a path or provider.

    Returns:
        Folded lowercase title used by Policy C ranking.
    """
    cleaned = normalize_title(value)
    cleaned = _PUNCT_TO_SPACE.sub(" ", cleaned)
    cleaned = _NON_ALNUM_SPACE.sub(" ", cleaned)
    cleaned = _MULTI_SPACE.sub(" ", cleaned).strip()
    return cleaned

def titles_match_exact(left: str, right: str) -> bool:
    """Return True when two titles are equal after punctuation folding.

    Args:
        left: First title.
        right: Second title.

    Returns:
        Whether the folded forms are identical.
    """
    return fold_title_for_match(left) == fold_title_for_match(right)

docs.title: rank_title_match(query, candidate)
docs.text:
Return a sortable score for candidate quality, or None if unrelated.

Higher tuple is better: (tier, folded_length).

  • tier 3 = exact
  • tier 2 = query ⊆ candidate
  • tier 1 = candidate ⊆ query (parent franchise)

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default query str

Title from the media path / identity.

required candidate str

Title from Arr or TMDB.

required

Returns:

Type Description tuple[int, int] | None

Sortable score tuple, or None when titles are unrelated.

Source code in src/media_cover_art/title_match.py 
def rank_title_match(query: str, candidate: str) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    """Return a sortable score for candidate quality, or None if unrelated.

    Higher tuple is better: ``(tier, folded_length)``.

    - tier 3 = exact
    - tier 2 = query ⊆ candidate
    - tier 1 = candidate ⊆ query (parent franchise)

    Args:
        query: Title from the media path / identity.
        candidate: Title from Arr or TMDB.

    Returns:
        Sortable score tuple, or ``None`` when titles are unrelated.
    """
    needle = fold_title_for_match(query)
    normalized = fold_title_for_match(candidate)
    if not needle or not normalized:
        return None

    if needle == normalized:
        return (3, len(normalized))

    needle_tokens = needle.split()
    candidate_tokens = normalized.split()
    if not needle_tokens or not candidate_tokens:
        return None

    query_in_candidate = (
        len(needle_tokens) <= len(candidate_tokens)
        and candidate_tokens[: len(needle_tokens)] == needle_tokens
    ) or _word_boundary_contains(normalized, needle)

    candidate_in_query = (
        len(candidate_tokens) < len(needle_tokens)
        and needle_tokens[: len(candidate_tokens)] == candidate_tokens
    ) or (
        len(candidate_tokens) < len(needle_tokens)
        and _word_boundary_contains(needle, normalized)
    )

    if query_in_candidate:
        return (2, len(normalized))
    if candidate_in_query:
        return (1, len(normalized))
    return None

Pick the best library/search item for title using Policy C ranking.

Optional year filter; mismatched years are skipped when both set.

Returns:

Type Description dict[str, Any] | None

Source code in src/media_cover_art/title_match.py 
def pick_best_item_by_title(
    items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    title: str,
    year: int | None,
    *,
    candidate_titles: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], list[str]],
    item_year: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], int | None],
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Pick the best library/search item for title using Policy C ranking.

    Args:
        items: Provider result dicts (Arr library rows or TMDB search hits).
        title: Query title from media identity.
        year: Optional year filter; mismatched years are skipped when both set.
        candidate_titles: Extracts candidate title strings from an item.
        item_year: Extracts an optional year from an item.

    Returns:
        The best matching item, or ``None`` if nothing ranks.
    """
    best_item: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    best_score: tuple[int, int] | None = None

    for item in items:
        year_value = item_year(item)
        year_ok = year is None or year_value is None or int(year_value) == int(year)
        if not year_ok:
            continue

        item_best: tuple[int, int] | None = None
        for candidate in candidate_titles(item):
            if not candidate:
                continue
            score = rank_title_match(title, candidate)
            if score is None:
                continue
            if item_best is None or score > item_best:
                item_best = score

        if item_best is None:
            continue
        if best_score is None or item_best > best_score:
            best_score = item_best
            best_item = item

    return best_item

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Shared contract: MongoDB collection media.cover_art_cache.

Walker / website3
      │
      ▼
 media_cover_art (identity → Arr/TMDB → cache)
      │
      ▼
 cover_art_cache (cache_key, status, remote_url, local_path?, …)
  • remote_url is the cross-host value (Walker prefetch + push notifications).
  • local_path is optional and host-specific (website FastAPI disk cache).

Full resolve/hydrate flow is implemented in Phase 1+.

docs.title: Path → identity
docs.text:
parse_media_identity derives kind, title, year / season / episode, display_title, and cache_key from full media paths.

Path signal Result Contains Films kind=film, key film:{slug} or film:{slug}:{year} Contains TV kind=tv, key tvshow:{slug} (series poster) Else kind=unknown (no remote lookup)

docs.title: Policy C title matching
docs.text:
Spinoff-safe ranking used by Arr/TMDB pickers:

  1. Punctuation-folded exact match
  2. Query ⊆ candidate (prefer longer)
  3. Candidate ⊆ query (parent franchise), still longest

See fold_title_for_match, rank_title_match, and pick_best_item_by_title in the API reference.
